summary_1line: Disguised Nala drives Rituparna’s chariot with astonishing speed toward Vidarbha while Varshneya suspects his identity and Rituparna demonstrates uncanny mathematical skill.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vahuka urges four lean horses forward as the chariot seems to fly through the sky over rivers and forests.
Rituparna points at a fruit-laden Vibhitaka tree while boasting he can count its millions of leaves and fruits at a glance.
Varshneya watches the chariot race like the wind, studying Vahuka and wondering if the misshapen driver is truly King Nala.
